verses.note: The church received these verses in its lectionaries and translations for centuries, and the Council of Trent (1546) declared the biblical books canonical with all their parts as read in the church and the Latin Vulgate, which includes them. Christians agree on what the passage says; they differ on whether it is Mark's, and most Protestant and Catholic scholars now build no doctrine on it alone.
Paul assumes a body of writings his Gentile and Jewish readers both recognize as holy and authoritative. The New Testament's first claim about the Old is that it belongs to the gospel.
